MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 8 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 8
   C. 10
   D. 17

2. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 17
   C. 16
   D. 0

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 48

4. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 21
   C. 15
   D. 3

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 36

7. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 37
   C. 13
   D. 5

8. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 81

9. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 16
   C. 64
   D. 65

10. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 13

11. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

12. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

Working:
1. Formula / relationship: x = RHS − constant
2. Substitute values: x = 17 − 8
3. x = 9
Final Answer: x = 9
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. C — 16
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Product = first factor × second factor
2. Substitute values: Product = 4 × 4
3. Product = 16
Final Answer: 16
Mark reminder: method mark for multiplication; accuracy mark for answer
